title: Eleven Kinds on One Acre
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：variety　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 variety 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My great-uncle grew eleven ① varieties of apple on one acre and could name every one of them with his eyes shut, by the fruit alone. He said a ② variety of apples is not the same as a lot of apples, and that the difference between the two is the whole of agriculture.

The ③ variety he was famous for — a small green apple that kept until March — had no name, and he would not give it one: he said a variety without a name is a variety nobody can buy, and that was the point. What he wanted, and what the county did not want, was ④ variety. Eleven kinds on one acre means eleven harvests, and never a week in which everything fails at once.

In 1961 a man from the ministry came to measure the ⑤ variety of his acre, wrote down nine, and my great-uncle said eleven; the man said two of them were the same apple, and my great-uncle said they were not, and the man wrote nine. ⑥ For the sake of variety, he said afterwards, the ministry would have had him grow wheat on the whole acre, and then there would have been one harvest and one failure and one year.

In 1974 the village ⑦ variety show was held in his barn — eleven acts, one piano and a dog — and he said afterwards that he had seen a ⑧ new variety of courage in the girl who sang second, and that she had more of it than the whole acre.

The ⑨ variety in that acre is what saved the family in 1976, the worst year of his life: nine of the eleven cropped and two did not, and he said that is what variety is for. When he died, in 1989, the ⑩ varieties went with him — eleven trees, no names, and a grandson who can tell two of them apart — and no variety, he had once said, survives the man who grew it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. （动植物的）品种；变种（常用复数 varieties）
B. n. （某一个具体的）品种；品类
C. n. 变化；多样性；多样化
D. 固定搭配：a variety of ... 各种各样的……
E. 固定搭配：the variety of ... ……的种类／品种之多
F. 固定搭配：for the sake of variety 为了换换花样；为了多样性
G. 固定搭配：variety show 综艺节目；综合演出
H. 固定搭配：a new variety of ... 一种新的……；一种别样的……

items.q: eleven varieties of apple on one acre
a variety of apples is not the same
The variety he was famous for
what the county did not want, was variety
to measure the variety of his acre
For the sake of variety, he said afterwards
the village variety show was held in his barn
he had seen a new variety of courage
The variety in that acre is what saved

answers.why: varieties 意为“品种”，他在一英亩地上种了十一个苹果品种，闭着眼睛只靠果子就能叫出名字。
a variety of apples 意为“各种各样的苹果”，他说品种繁多的苹果不等于数量众多的苹果。
the variety 意为“（某一个具体的）品种、品类”，他最有名的那个品种是一种小小的青苹果，能放到三月。
variety 意为“多样性、多样化”，他要的是多样化，而郡里不要。
the variety of his acre 意为“他那英亩地上的品种（之多）”，1961 年部里的人来统计他地里的品种。
for the sake of variety 意为“为了换换花样、为了多样性”，他说部里为了多样化，会让他整块地都种小麦。
variety show 意为“综艺节目、综合演出”，1974 年村里的综合演出就在他的谷仓里举行。
a new variety of ... 意为“一种新的……、一种别样的……”，他说他在第二个唱歌的女孩身上看到了一种别样的勇气。
the variety 意为“多样性”，正是那块地的多样性在 1976 年救了这一家：十一种里有九种结果，两种没结。
varieties 意为“品种”，他 1989 年去世时，那些品种也随他而去：十一棵树，没有名字。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 他在一英亩地上种了十一个苹果品种，闭着眼睛就能叫出名字。（variety）
他说，品种繁多的苹果不等于数量众多的苹果。（a variety of）
他最有名的品种没有名字，他也不肯给它取一个。（variety）
他要的是多样性：一英亩十一种，十一次收成。（variety）
1961 年部里的人来统计他地里的品种，记下九种，他说是十一种。（the variety of）
为了换换花样，部里会让他整块地都种小麦。（for the sake of variety）
answers: He grew eleven varieties of apple on one acre and could name every one with his eyes shut.
He said a variety of apples is not the same as a lot of apples.
The variety he was famous for had no name, and he would not give it one.
What he wanted was variety: eleven kinds on one acre, eleven harvests.
In 1961 a man from the ministry came to measure the variety of his acre and wrote down nine; he said eleven.
For the sake of variety, the ministry would have had him grow wheat on the whole acre.
